name: mcp
title: MCP Hub
description: One hub for every MCP server. Finds the local fleet twice over — what a mod declares in config.json and what a live port sweep catches it serving — registers any remote server (with auth headers), browses the public MCP directories, and re-exposes the union as a single MCP server: point one client at POST /mcp and every upstream tool is callable as server__tool. Carries web_search and web_fetch itself, with no API key required.
backend: mcp-rs (Rust: axum REST registry + JSON-RPC 2.0 Streamable HTTP gateway + stdio)

servers.docs: GET: every aggregated server (fleet-discovered + user-registered) with its live probe (status, serverInfo, tool count, latency). POST {url, id?, name?, headers?, note?, force?}: probe-then-register a remote MCP server; a server that fails the handshake is rejected unless force:true

servers/:id.docs: GET one server row. DELETE unregisters a user server; a fleet server is disabled instead (it would re-appear on the next scan)

servers/:id/refresh.docs: Re-probe one server now (initialize + tools/list). A local mod that is asleep is woken through the activator; ?wake=0 leaves it asleep

servers/:id/toggle.docs: {enabled: bool} — include or exclude a server from aggregation without deleting it

probe.docs: {url, headers?} — ad-hoc MCP handshake against any URL; returns protocolVersion, serverInfo and the full tool list; nothing is saved

tools.docs: The aggregated tool list, every tool namespaced server__tool with a [server] description prefix; ?server= filters to one upstream

call.docs: REST shortcut around tools/call: {tool: 'server__tool', args} or {server, tool, args}; returns the upstream's MCP result verbatim

client_config.docs: ?client=claude|cursor|vscode|json — paste-ready client config (or the `claude mcp add` one-liner) pointing at this hub's /mcp

stats.docs: Totals: servers, up/down, aggregated tools, by_source, whether the write gate is armed

refresh.docs: Re-scan the fleet for new MCP mods and re-probe every enabled server

mcp.auth: tools/call needs a credential unless the caller is on this host; initialize and tools/list are open
mcp.docs: The hub as an MCP server (JSON-RPC 2.0, Streamable HTTP; also `mcp-api --stdio`). tools/list = union of every enabled upstream + 5 native tools; tools/call on server__tool proxies to the owning upstream with automatic session handshake, waking a sleeping fleet mod through the activator if it has to

intake.docs: {text} — parse a URL, a store/IPFS CID, an mcpServers config blob, a `claude mcp add` one-liner or a QR payload into candidate servers. Nothing is registered

search.docs: ?q=&count=&provider= — search the web. Providers are tried in order: brave, tavily, exa, serper (key required, from env or ~/.mod/mcp/web.json), then keenable (public, keyless), then DuckDuckGo instant answers. A chain that finds nothing still returns 200, with results:[], the per-provider `tried` trace and `error` saying why — only a missing `q` or a pinned provider with no key is a 400

fetch.docs: ?url=&max_chars= — read one public page as text (HTML stripped), falling back to a reader service when a site blocks the direct request. Loopback and private addresses are refused

catalog.docs: ?q=&registry=featured|official|smithery|all&limit= — search the public MCP directories live. Rows carry a URL ready to POST to /servers; nothing is registered here

discover.docs: Live sweep: knock on every port the fleet mentions and adopt whatever completes an MCP handshake, declared or not. Also runs in the background every MCP_SWEEP_SECS

auth/me.docs: Who the hub thinks you are (wallet session, API key, local caller or anonymous) and what that allows

keys.docs: GET: minted API keys (hash withheld). POST {name}: mint one — the plaintext is returned exactly once

mcp.namespacing: server__tool (double underscore; server ids are sanitized so they can never contain __)
mcp.nested_hubs: Aggregating another hub works: the split is on the FIRST __, so otherhub__github__create_issue routes to otherhub, which routes to github

id.description: Hub-unique id; becomes the tool-name prefix

headers.description: Extra headers sent on every upstream request (e.g. Authorization). Stored off-tree, values never echoed by the API

source.description: fleet = auto-discovered from a mod's config.json endpoints.mcp; user = registered via POST /servers

declared.rule: a mod whose config.json has endpoints.mcp, urls.mcp or a top-level mcp block is aggregated; url = urls.mcp/mcp.url, else localhost:{mcp.port|mcp_port|gateway_port|port|api.port|port in urls.api}{mcp path, default /mcp}; core wins name collisions; the hub never aggregates itself

swept.rule: every port any config mentions is knocked on at /mcp; whatever completes a handshake is kept as source=sweep. Finds mods that serve MCP without declaring it. Declared rows outrank swept ones, user rows outrank both

asleep.rule: a scaled-to-zero mod refuses its own port; explicit re-probes and tool calls retry through the activator at {MCP_ACTIVATOR_URL}/api/{mod}{path}, which wakes it. Background probes do not wake anything

auth.identity: borrowed from orbit/build — the same wallet session token, validated here against ~/.mod/build/server.secret. The hub never mints one
auth.calls: tool execution needs an owner/editor wallet, a hub API key (mcphub_…), or a caller on this host (no X-Forwarded-* header). MCP_GATE_LOCAL=1 gates local callers too; MCP_OPEN_CALLS=1 opens everyone
auth.writes: registry edits need an owner/editor wallet, Bearer ~/.mod/mcp/server.secret, or a caller on this host
auth.keys: minted owner-only; only the sha256 is stored; a key buys tool calls, never registry edits

env.MCP_HUB_DIR: Off-tree state: hub.json registry, probes.json cache, server.secret (default ~/.mod/mcp)
env.MCP_PUBLIC_URL: Public base URL used in client_config output (default http://localhost:50360)
env.MCP_ACTIVATOR_URL: Scale-to-zero proxy used to wake sleeping mods (default http://127.0.0.1:9000)
env.MCP_WEB_SEARCH_URL: Keyless MCP search server backing web_search (default https://api.keenable.ai/mcp)
env.MCP_FETCH_ALLOW_LOCAL: 1 lets web_fetch read loopback/private addresses (off by default)
env.MCP_GATE_LOCAL: 1 demands a credential from callers on this host too
env.BRAVE_API_KEY|TAVILY_API_KEY|EXA_API_KEY: Optional web-search keys; ~/.mod/mcp/web.json holds them too
